repos.description: User-friendly AI Interface (Supports Ollama, OpenAI API, ...)
repos.summary_zh: Open WebUI是功能完备的自托管AI平台，无缝集成Ollama与OpenAI API，支持完全离线部署。内置RAG推理引擎和原生Python函数调用工具，提供细粒度用户权限管理、响应式界面及PWA移动应用。支持语音/视频通话、Markdown/LaTeX渲染，可通过插件系统扩展功能。提供Docker/Kubernetes部署方案，适用于企业级AI应用开发与私有化大模型部署场景。
repos.summary_en: Open WebUI is a comprehensive self-hosted AI platform that seamlessly integrates Ollama and OpenAI-compatible APIs with full offline deployment capability. Featuring a built-in RAG inference engine and native Python function calling tools, it offers granular user permissions, responsive design, and PWA mobile support. The platform enables voice/video calls, Markdown/LaTeX rendering, and extensible plugin architecture. Deployable via Docker/Kubernetes, it serves as an enterprise-grade solution for private LLM orchestration and AI application development requiring air-gapped security.

repos.description: Course to get into Large Language Models (LLMs) with roadmaps and Colab notebooks.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个免费的LLM系统学习课程，提供从数学基础到工程实践的完整路线图。课程分为三部分：LLM基础、LLM科学家（模型构建与优化）和LLM工程师（应用开发与部署）。包含大量实用的Google Colab notebooks，涵盖模型微调、合并、量化、评估等实战技术，并配套自动化工具，适合想深入LLM领域的开发者。
repos.summary_en: This is a free, comprehensive LLM course offering structured learning paths from mathematical foundations to production deployment. The curriculum is divided into three parts: LLM Fundamentals, The LLM Scientist (focusing on building optimal models with cutting-edge techniques), and The LLM Engineer (covering application development and deployment). It provides extensive Google Colab notebooks for hands-on practice, including tools for fine-tuning, model merging, quantization, and automated evaluation. Based on the LLM Engineer's Handbook, it's designed for developers seeking practical LLM expertise.

repos.description: Unified Efficient Fine-Tuning of 100+ LLMs & VLMs (ACL 2024)
repos.summary_zh: LlamaFactory是一个统一的大语言模型与多模态模型高效微调框架，支持100+预训练模型。提供零代码命令行工具和基于Gradio的Web UI，大幅降低微调门槛。该框架在ACL 2024发表，已被Amazon、NVIDIA、阿里云等企业采用，支持云端部署和本地训练，集成LoRA、QLoRA等高效微调技术，是学术界和工业界广泛使用的微调解决方案。
repos.summary_en: LlamaFactory is a unified framework for efficient fine-tuning of 100+ large language and vision-language models. It offers zero-code CLI and Gradio-powered Web UI, dramatically lowering the barrier to model customization. Published at ACL 2024 and adopted by industry leaders including Amazon, NVIDIA, and Aliyun, it supports both cloud deployment and local training. The framework integrates advanced parameter-efficient techniques like LoRA and QLoRA, making it a widely-used solution for streamlined model adaptation in academic and industrial settings.

repos.description: 《动手学大模型Dive into LLMs》系列编程实践教程
repos.summary_zh: 本教程源自上海交大课程，提供大模型全栈实践指南。涵盖微调部署、提示工程、知识编辑、数学推理、模型水印、越狱攻击等前沿主题。每个章节配套Jupyter Notebook脚本与课件，支持华为昇腾国产化平台。适合高校教学、学术研究与工业实践，助力快速掌握大模型开发与安全攻防技术。
repos.summary_en: This hands-on tutorial series, derived from Shanghai Jiao Tong University courses, offers comprehensive LLMs practical guidance. Covering fine-tuning, prompting, knowledge editing, math reasoning, model watermarking, and jailbreak attacks. Each chapter includes Jupyter notebooks and slides, supporting Huawei Ascend platform. Ideal for academic teaching, research, and industrial practice in LLM development and security.

repos.summary_zh: 微软官方1-bit大模型推理框架，专为1.58-bit三元模型优化。基于llama.cpp构建，提供CPU/GPU无损快速推理，性能提升最高6.17倍，能耗降低82%。支持单CPU运行100B参数模型，速度达5-7 token/秒。采用查找表与并行内核技术，实现边缘设备高效部署，推动大模型本地化应用。
repos.summary_en: Microsoft's official inference framework for 1-bit LLMs, optimized for 1.58-bit ternary models. Built on llama.cpp, it delivers lossless fast inference on CPU/GPU with up to 6.17x speedup and 82% energy reduction. Enables running 100B-parameter models on a single CPU at human reading speed (5-7 tokens/sec). Features optimized kernels using lookup table methodologies and parallel implementations with configurable tiling and embedding quantization. Empowers efficient edge deployment of large models, advancing local AI applications.

repos.description: A vector index built on TurboQuant, written in Rust with Python bindings
repos.summary_zh: turbovec 是基于 Google TurboQuant 算法的 Rust 向量索引库，提供 Python 绑定。无需训练即可在线摄入向量，将 1000 万 float32 向量从 31GB 压缩至 4GB，搜索速度媲美或超越 FAISS。支持 SIMD 优化内核、搜索时内核过滤、稳定 ID 及 O(1) 删除，专为隐私敏感、低内存、低延迟的 RAG 场景设计，支持 LangChain 等框架无缝集成，实现完全本地化向量搜索。
repos.summary_en: turbovec is a Rust vector index with Python bindings built on Google's TurboQuant algorithm. It enables training-free online ingestion, compressing a 10M float32 vector corpus from 31GB to 4GB while matching or exceeding FAISS search speeds via SIMD kernels. Features include in-kernel filtering for hybrid retrieval, stable IDs with O(1) deletes, and persistence. Ideal for privacy-focused, memory-efficient, low-latency RAG, with drop-in integrations for LangChain, LlamaIndex, and others for fully local vector search.

repos.description: A powerful tool for creating datasets for LLM fine-tuning 、RAG and Eval
repos.summary_zh: Easy Dataset 是一款专为大语言模型训练设计的数据集构建工具。它支持 PDF、Markdown、DOCX 等格式的智能解析与切分，可自动生成高质量问答对、多轮对话及图像问答数据集。内置领域标签树、数据清洗和增强功能，适用于微调、RAG 和评估场景。1.7.0 版本新增评估系统。
repos.summary_en: Easy Dataset is a specialized tool for building LLM training datasets. It intelligently parses and chunks documents in PDF, Markdown, DOCX, TXT, and EPUB formats, automatically generating high-quality QA pairs, multi-turn dialogues, and visual QA datasets. Features include domain label trees, data cleaning/augmentation, and support for fine-tuning, RAG, and evaluation scenarios. Version 1.7.0 introduces a comprehensive evaluation system with multi-dimensional assessment and human blind testing capabilities for domain-specific model validation, post-fine-tuning evaluation, and RAG recall rate assessment tasks in production environments.

repos.description: OCR model that handles complex tables, forms, handwriting with full layout.
repos.summary_zh: Chandra OCR 2 是业界领先的文档智能模型，专精于复杂表格、手写体及数学公式的精准识别。支持90+语言，完美保留原始布局，输出HTML/Markdown/JSON结构化数据。提供本地(HuggingFace)与云端(vLLM)双模式，在手写表单、技术文档等场景表现卓越，是企业级文档自动化的核心引擎。
repos.summary_en: Chandra OCR 2 is a state-of-the-art document intelligence model excelling at complex tables, handwriting, and mathematical formulas. Supporting 90+ languages, it preserves full layout fidelity while outputting structured HTML/Markdown/JSON. With dual inference modes (local HuggingFace and remote vLLM), it delivers exceptional performance for forms, technical documents, and multilingual content, serving as a core engine for enterprise document automation.

repos.description: 《大语言模型》作者：赵鑫，李军毅，周昆，唐天一，文继荣
repos.summary_zh: 本书系统阐述大语言模型技术体系，涵盖预训练、微调、对齐及提示工程等核心内容。基于作者团队前沿研究与工业实践，提供完整技术框架与路线图，配套教学课件。适合具深度学习基础的读者入门大模型技术，可作为高校课程与行业研发权威参考。
repos.summary_en: This book systematically presents the comprehensive technical framework of Large Language Models, covering fundamental aspects including pre-training, fine-tuning, alignment, and prompt engineering. Based on the authors' pioneering research and practical industrial experience in developing models like Wenlan and Yulan, it offers a structured learning roadmap with supplementary lecture slides. Aimed at readers with foundational deep learning knowledge, this authoritative volume serves as an essential reference for both academic courses and industrial R&D in LLM technology, bridging theoretical concepts with real-world implementation.

repos.description: AI-powered penetration testing assistant using local LLM on linux (Parrot OS)
repos.summary_zh: METATRON是一款完全本地运行的CLI渗透测试AI助手，基于Ollama部署的定制Qwen模型（metatron-qwen），自动调用nmap、whois、nikto等真实侦察工具，结合DuckDuckGo与CVE查询，进行漏洞分析、利用建议与修复推荐。支持Agentic循环、MariaDB全量历史存储及PDF/HTML报告导出，无需云端或API密钥，专为Parrot OS等Linux环境打造。
repos.summary_en: METATRON is a fully local CLI AI penetration testing assistant powered by a custom Qwen model (metatron-qwen) via Ollama. It automates real recon tools (nmap, whois, nikto, etc.), integrates DuckDuckGo and CVE lookups, and performs vulnerability analysis, exploit suggestions, and fix recommendations. Features an agentic loop, MariaDB history storage, and PDF/HTML report export. Runs entirely offline with no API keys, designed for Parrot OS and Linux.

repos.description: RAG Web UI is an intelligent dialogue system based on RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) technology.
repos.summary_zh: RAG Web UI是基于RAG技术的智能对话系统，用于构建私有化知识库问答服务。支持PDF、DOCX、Markdown等文档的自动分块与向量化，兼容OpenAI、DeepSeek及Ollama本地模型，可切换ChromaDB/Qdrant向量数据库。具备多轮对话、引用溯源、异步处理及OpenAPI接口，适用于企业知识库与智能客服场景。
repos.summary_en: RAG Web UI is an intelligent dialogue system based on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) technology for building private knowledge base Q&A services. It offers comprehensive document management supporting PDF, DOCX, Markdown formats with automatic chunking and vectorization. The system features a frontend-backend separated architecture, flexible LLM support (OpenAI, DeepSeek, Ollama), and interchangeable vector databases (ChromaDB, Qdrant) via Factory pattern. Production-ready capabilities include multi-turn dialogue, citation tracking, async processing, and OpenAPI interfaces, suitable for enterprise knowledge bases and intelligent customer service applications.

repos.description: Official repository of my book "A Hands-On Guide to Fine-Tuning LLMs with PyTorch and Hugging Face"
repos.summary_zh: 这是一本使用PyTorch和Hugging Face微调大语言模型的实战指南。系统讲解量化、LoRA低秩适配、数据集格式化等稳定核心技术，涵盖模型加载、SFTTrainer微调到本地部署全流程。提供可直接运行的Google Colab notebooks，适合具备Transformer基础的中级开发者深入理解配置原理与底层实现。
repos.summary_en: A hands-on guide repository for fine-tuning Large Language Models with PyTorch and Hugging Face. Covers quantization, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), and dataset formatting templates through practical Colab notebooks. Includes complete workflow from loading quantized models to supervised fine-tuning with SFTTrainer and local deployment. Targets intermediate practitioners, explaining configuration principles and stable concepts essential for adapting to evolving LLM technologies.

repos.description: Unofficial tracker for Ollama cloud models that work on the Free tier.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是非官方的 Ollama 云模型免费 tier 追踪器。通过自动化脚本定期探测模型可用性，维护动态表格标注✅（免费可用）或🔒（需订阅），并显示使用量级别。最新检查于 2026-08-03，涵盖 Gemma、Qwen、DeepSeek 等众多大模型。帮助开发者、研究人员和 AI 爱好者免费实验高级 LLM，最大化利用免费云资源，优化成本与工作流。
repos.summary_en: This repository is an unofficial tracker for Ollama cloud models accessible on the free tier. It uses automated scripts for periodic probing to maintain a dynamic table marking ✅ for free access or 🔒 for subscription-required models, along with usage intensity levels. Last updated 2026-08-03, it covers models like Gemma, Qwen, and DeepSeek. It helps developers, researchers, and AI enthusiasts experiment with advanced LLMs cost-free, optimizing free cloud resources and workflows.
